//: The tests run under Node, not under Vite, so they need `types: node` for `node:test` and `node:assert` — which the app project must not have. Same split tsconfig.node.json already makes for vite.config.ts. DOM stays in `lib` because the modules under test are app modules and one of them touches `document`; nothing in a test calls it. `erasableSyntaxOnly` is not optional here: Node strips the types rather than compiling them, so anything it cannot erase would be a runtime error instead of a type error.
